delete.description:
Soft delete: the area disappears from lists and pickers, and its name can be used
again; history keeps it. 409 AREA_IN_USE while a corridor uses it.

patch.description:
Everything that refers to the area shows the new name. Renaming to the current name
changes nothing.

get.description:
Every recorded change, filtered by entity or actor. Names, emails and other personal
values never appear: the entries show only that they changed.
With both areas' names. Deleted corridors are not listed.

post.description:
Requires `Idempotency-Key`. 409 CORRIDOR_EXISTS: a live corridor has this pair (the
way back is another corridor). An area that doesn't exist is a 422 on its field.

parameters.description: One per user action, reused on every retry of it (api-contract.md).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

delete.description: Soft delete: hidden from lists, its pair free again; history keeps it.

patch.description: Leave an end out to keep it. The result must be two different areas.

get.description: Every staff member, deactivated ones included unless filtered out.

post.description:
Supabase emails them a link to set a password. They are active staff in `role` at
once, and can sign in when they have accepted. Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Each admin
may send 20 invites an hour (refusals and replays do not count).

- 409 STAFF_EMAIL_TAKEN: a staff member, active or not, has this email (reactivate them).
- 409 AUTH_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: the email already has a sign-in account. An operator deletes
  that Supabase user if it should not exist, then the invite can be sent (README).
- 503: Supabase could not send the invite; retrying with the same key is safe.

parameters.description: One per user action, reused on every retry of it (api-contract.md).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present on a retry answered with the stored response.

409.description: Email Already Used By Staff, Request In Progress, Sign-In Account Already Exists

get.description: Your ID, name, email and role. The admin portal calls it after sign-in.

patch.description:
Promote, demote, deactivate or reactivate. No Idempotency-Key: setting a value that
is already there changes nothing.

- 409 LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: the change would leave no active admin.
patch.summary: Change a staff member's role or status (admins only)
